finding.title: Vulnerability alerts were tested with the wrong HTTP method and were falsely classified as NOT_AVAILABLE
evidence: Executor command recorded: gh api -X POST repos/KayzenRoot/iris/vulnerability-alerts -> 404
GitHub REST contract enables vulnerability alerts with PUT, not POST
GET 404 means vulnerability alerts are not enabled; it does not prove platform unavailability
Automated security fixes then returned 422 because vulnerability alerts were not enabled
requiredCorrection: Use PUT /repos/KayzenRoot/iris/vulnerability-alerts and verify the follow-up GET returns 204
Then use PUT /repos/KayzenRoot/iris/automated-security-fixes and read back enabled state
Update Evidence Bundle truthfully from actual readback
Re-run/observe exact-head Governance and gh pr checks 14 --required
Do not change the already-correct ruleset/repository settings except if a readback proves drift
